parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.733 indicates meaningful structural overlap between fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnDecodingError (line 84) and fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnCancellationError (line 103), these are distinct test cases exercising different error paths (decoding failure vs. cancellation), and their near-duplication is intentional: each must independently assert the correct behaviour for its specific error condition. Merging or extracting them into a shared helper would obscure the intent of each test and couple unrelated failure semantics.
